name: xflickr_crawl_health_stale

query_condition.sql: SELECT count(CASE WHEN event='crawl.health' AND _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '90 seconds' THEN 1 END) AS health_recent, count(CASE WHEN event='crawl.health.key' AND _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '90 seconds' THEN 1 END) AS key_recent FROM "{{OPENOBSERVE_STREAM}}" HAVING health_recent=0 OR key_recent=0

description: Impact: Crawl health or per-key quota telemetry is missing or stale. Action: Check the configured OpenObserve destination, stream, and XFlickr telemetry delivery.
